fix: Give each handoff-pair stage key a signal emitter at its decision site, with the would-fields the shadow contract needs. Then remove the 5 no-signal rows and lower baselineCeiling back to 82.

summary: K4a made the stage-key list complete. Five handoff-pair stage keys (handoff.build-audit.stage, handoff.intent-scout.stage, handoff.scout-triage.stage and two more) have no signal emitter, so they can never collect shadow evidence, and K5 can never switch them on. K4a recorded them as 5 no-signal rows in go/internal/gateregistry/testdata/stage_violations.json and raised baselineCeiling from 82 to 87.
title: The five handoff-pair stage keys emit their shadow signals
